scope: Explicit per-row JVPR2 verdict metadata, native targeting, scorer provenance and JVPR1 compatibility

executed_checks.same_byte_length_rationale_substitution_: decision prefix disagrees with corpus verdict prefix
executed_checks.scorer_fixture_note: Metadata validator fixture combines real native token metadata with synthetic correctness/margin fields; no inference accuracy is measured.

resolved_findings.finding: Whitespace at the findings boundary could select punctuation unrelated to the empty/nonempty contrast.
resolved_findings.resolution: Packer and native loader require compact role-specific findings continuations; native counterfactual re-tokenization verifies the reciprocal alternative after each row's own prefix.

resolved_findings.finding: Prefix byte lengths alone did not identify the exact source rationale.
resolved_findings.resolution: Native initial metadata records the exact prefix string; scorer compares its content and byte length before emitting its digest.
resolved_findings.evidence: Independent references() check rejects a same-byte-length bad-to-sad rationale substitution.

source_review_checks: Both local prefix IDs and counterfactual prefix IDs must equal the full answer prefix; tokenizer truncation and EOS selections fail.
Counterfactual combines each row's exact prefix with its partner's findings suffix and checks the next ID against the reciprocal alternative without an equal decoded-width assumption.
Independent positions flow through decision_order, joint coefficients, prefix totals, readout consistency and gradient probe.
JVPR1 retains first divergent non-EOS token selection and equal-position scorer validation.
Packer/scorer perform full duplicate-key and findings-item validation; native gate validates JSON structure, unique top-level findings, exact boundary, compact role and native token relationships.
